items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: But now, the funny thing, you should hear Bob Martin speak. He has a strictly British accent.

ctx.x: That's you? That's the British for you. Well, I'll pick up the British accent. I came back to New Orleans there to get my... Yeah, the Mid-Atlantic accent. This is Spanish Diamond Poets, Mid-Atlantic band.

But now, the funny thing, you should hear Bob Martin speak. He has a strictly British accent. Oh, yeah. And you should hear him sing Sister Kate on this. He sound like some black cat who just came from Mississippi. Yeah. Singing all this rhythm.
You said loin. Huh? You said loin. Right. Loin.
